title: Require the coverage-enforcing check in mongodb-mcp-server main branch protection
description: In GitHub repository OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server, add the status check(s) that now fail on the coverage threshold from task 1 (the Code Health 'run-tests' job and/or the 'coverage' job) to the required status checks of branch protection on main, with 'Require branches to be up to date' enabled. This is a repository settings change by a repo admin; record the before and after JSON of the protection rule as evidence. No deployment window applies (CI settings only).
acceptanceCriteria: `gh api repos/OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server/branches/main/protection --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts'` lists the coverage-enforcing check name(s) from task 1.

A pull request whose coverage check is failing shows 'Required' on that check and the merge button stays blocked for non-admin users (screenshot or `gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus` showing BLOCKED attached).

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer inspects the attached `gh api .../branches/main/protection` output before and after the change. Expected: required_status_checks.contexts contains the coverage-enforcing job name, and a blocked PR's mergeStateStatus is BLOCKED while that check fails.

rootCause.description: Even a failing coverage job would not stop a merge unless it is a required status check. Branch protection on main was never updated to include the unit-test and coverage gate that policy calls blocking.
